_readme: Settings for the Full Stack Designers site. The copy of this file in the root of the full-stack-designers.github.io repo wins: edit it there, and the next build uses it.
link_to_portfolio: true or false. When true, the footer of every page links to Clint's portfolio. The address of the portfolio is not stored in this public file; the build fills it in.
reading_aid: the sentence highlight that follows the scroll and the mouse. The settings mean the same as in the portfolio's work-config.json:
scroll_per_line: for a short text, how many pixels of scrolling each line of a sentence is worth before the highlight moves on. Smaller is faster.
reading_point: for a long text, where on the screen the highlighted sentence sits. 0 is the top, 1 is the bottom.
catch_up_ms: after a fast scroll, the longest time in milliseconds the highlight spends on each sentence it missed.
hover: true or false. With a mouse, resting the pointer on a sentence highlights it.
hover_delay_ms: how long the pointer has to rest on a sentence before it is highlighted.
